title: TLS-safe-mode limitation note at port.c:1513 is unusually good
description: The NOTE block at port.c:1513-1519 proactively documents a known limitation: g_tls_safe_mode is process-global, disables hardware hash for ALL WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID objects (not just TLS), and explains the workaround (register a separate devId + callback for bulk-hash use). This comment is rare in embedded/crypto code — most limitations live only in the author's head. A contributor who wants to 'fix' TLS-safe mode by making it per-WOLFSSL object should read this comment first to understand the full implications.
